description: Defines a Semaphore class for concurrency control using mutexes and condition variables.

classes.name: Semaphore
classes.description: A semaphore class providing wait and post operations for thread synchronization.

methods.name: Semaphore
methods.description: Constructor initializing semaphore with initial value and capacity.

methods.name: SemWait
methods.description: Decrements the semaphore, blocking if the semaphore is at zero.

methods.name: SemPost
methods.description: Increments the semaphore, blocking if the semaphore is at capacity.
